name: Salterra, a Luxury Collection Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on pristine Grace Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, where powdery white sand meets impossibly turquoise waters in the protected Conch Cay Marine Reserve.
whats_special: Salterra is built on the site of the former Ocean Club resort, completely reimagined as a sophisticated adults-only retreat. The resort's name pays homage to the salt flats that made Turks & Caicos historically significant, while its design incorporates locally-sourced conch shells and limestone. As part of Marriott STARS, guests enjoy exclusive perks like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and late checkout.
pro_tip: Book during conch spawning season (July-September) when the surrounding waters become even more crystal clear, and you might spot baby sea turtles making their first journey to the ocean from nearby nesting sites.
dont_miss: The resort's signature salt cave spa treatment using pink Himalayan salt, and sunset dining at their overwater restaurant pier. Grace Bay's unique geography creates some of the Caribbean's most spectacular sunsets, with unobstructed views across the Caicos Banks where the shallow waters create an endless mirror effect.
pros: Pristine beachfront location on Grace Bay Beach
Luxury Collection standard with premium amenities
Marriott STARS Program benefits and recognition
Exclusive Turks & Caicos tropical paradise setting
